baseline_findings: C13 and C19 already contain lawful competitor BI, sourced recommendations and inactive weekly/monthly review designs; TG-001/TG-017 operationalize records and experiment handoff.
C16 and V2-G already contain the Academy curriculum, supervised Living Labs, Student360/Alumni360 and safe student work. TG additions do not replace curriculum or create new grading authority.

The retained EDU-RDI-001 template already governs the research-to-impact lifecycle, ethics, IP, open science, authorship, funding, commercialization and eight generic registers. TG-007/TG-008/TG-009 instantiate DUDOS programme contracts rather than claim research was missing altogether.
C15 already governs partners, recognition and appeals. Challenge charters, round-specific judging, COI/quorum and student-to-product admissions are the new operational additions.

C04/C17 and MPT-WEB already establish multi-tenancy, localization and accessibility. TG-011/TG-012/TG-013 add cross-institution membership and country/offer readiness behavior; DOL resource reservations and research/GPU quota controls remain authoritative mappings.

acceptance_tests.expected_result: Result is incomplete and no final rank is produced; zero is not substituted.

acceptance_tests.scenario: Appeal succeeds after provisional announcement

field_contract_notes: These are typed design requirements, not a deployed database migration or a claim of complete vendor schemas. Type aliases are embedded here; a developer must compile them into selected service contracts and verify cross-record constraints.

Common fields apply to every entity. Conditional fields remain absent/null in drafts until their stated transition; values are not fabricated. Implement transition-specific requiredness from the workflow rather than require every field on initial intake.
Store decisions separately with object/action/version, actor, authority, time, result and evidence. Never set approval from a score, color, template selection or generated draft.
Validate all referenced IDs against the same tenant/project or an explicit approved sharing contract. Public URIs and source text are untrusted inputs; apply URL-fetch and file safety controls.

Money remains decimal with currency and Finance-configured precision; no binary-float financial arithmetic. Shares and rubric weights need declared totals, precision, denominators and versioned rules; missing values remain missing.

Candidate country/locale catalogues require maintained validity and offer/provider applicability. More languages do not imply more sales territories. Draft field labels/help/errors require human locale/domain review before live use.
Selected ORCID integration requires actual API eligibility and OAuth configuration; unauthenticated IDs never inherit authenticated status. No ORCID or institutional API access has been activated.

metrics.privacy_rule: Publish permitted aggregates; suppress identifying small groups; no cross-tenant raw joins.

metrics.name: Research translation

metrics.privacy_rule: Publish permitted aggregates; suppress identifying small groups; no cross-tenant raw joins.

metrics.privacy_rule: Publish permitted aggregates; suppress identifying small groups; no cross-tenant raw joins.

metrics.privacy_rule: Publish permitted aggregates; suppress identifying small groups; no cross-tenant raw joins.

metrics.privacy_rule: Publish permitted aggregates; suppress identifying small groups; no cross-tenant raw joins.

implementation_phases.name: Prepare reusable programme contracts
implementation_phases.entry: Authorized design work and accessible retained masters
implementation_phases.exit: Named first programme, rights/participation terms, typed selected fields, human reviewers and scoped tests are specified. No production participation or sale is claimed.
implementation_phases.timing: Re-estimate with the main DUDOS plan; no extra fixed promise.

implementation_phases.name: Run one controlled local cohort and one customer problem
implementation_phases.entry: Programme-specific permissions, prepared sandbox and approved affected workflows
scope: One selected Daffodil/partner cohort with independent applicants where approved
implementation_phases.exit: Observed admission, judging/correction, pilot, handover and support evidence; price/rights gaps remain explicit.

implementation_phases.name: Repeat across institutions and commercialize selected output
implementation_phases.entry: Pilot evidence plus rights and maintainer
implementation_phases.exit: Second institution/tenant uses the same contracts; first qualified product/paid pilot or funded social deployment has rights, support and finance evidence.
implementation_phases.timing: Gate-based, not automatically triggered by a competition award.

implementation_phases.name: Expand one country and additional language at a time
implementation_phases.entry: Observed demand and approved selected country/offer requirements
implementation_phases.exit: Country-specific support, legal/commercial/provider/data conditions tested; next expansion decided from outcome and cost.

scoped_decisions.decision: Adopt the first programme’s challenge charter, eligibility, rubric, conflicts, quorum, tie/appeal rules and any funded prize terms.
scoped_decisions.owner_role: Challenge owner and independent judging chair; Finance for funded prizes
required_evidence: Prize budget evidence if a prize is promised
scoped_decisions.affected_action: Publishing binding participation/prize terms, accepting affected entries under those terms and issuing final awards.
scoped_decisions.independent_work_allowed: Prepare drafts, accessible forms, synthetic judging exercises, internal programme design and unrelated authorized customer work.

scoped_decisions.decision: Resolve ownership, permitted use and commercial benefit-sharing for the selected student/research output.
scoped_decisions.owner_role: Rights holders, institution Research/IP office and qualified legal reviewer
required_evidence: Contributor and third-party code/data/content rights inventory
Executed license/assignment and revenue-sharing terms for the chosen route
Public disclosure/IP protection decision where relevant
scoped_decisions.affected_action: Commercial reuse, redistribution, public disclosure or model training beyond existing granted scope for that output.
scoped_decisions.independent_work_allowed: Private review under existing permission, synthetic prototypes, rights negotiation, source inventory and other rights-cleared products.

scoped_decisions.decision: Approve the actual first live student/talent programme and any cross-institution or resource admission terms.
scoped_decisions.owner_role: Programme/academic owner, participating tenant and resource owners
required_evidence: Voluntary participation, work status and applicable compensation terms
Accepted project memberships and data-sharing scope
Actual resource capacity, quota and provider terms where selected
scoped_decisions.affected_action: Live participant admission, access to customer data, cross-institution project assets or restricted physical/compute resources.
scoped_decisions.independent_work_allowed: Open-interest intake with appropriate notice, private draft applications, sandbox simulations and non-personal programme planning.

scoped_decisions.decision: Select and validate the next country/entity/offer and the languages required for that offer.
scoped_decisions.owner_role: Country launch owner with qualified Legal, Finance, data and service owners
required_evidence: Observed demand hypothesis and supported offer
Payment, currency, invoice/tax and refund arrangement
Data location/transfer and contractual review for that scope
Real support hours/language capability and reviewed critical localized content
scoped_decisions.affected_action: Selling or processing restricted transactions/data for the selected country/offer; this does not prevent viewing a supported language or a lawful lead-only page.
scoped_decisions.independent_work_allowed: Market research, approved public content drafts, country assessment and supported existing-market services.

sources.title: WIPO: IP policies for universities and research institutions
sources.verified_claim: Institutional IP policy addresses ownership, use, disclosure, commercialization, third-party rights, benefit sharing and conflicts of interest; it must be adapted to the institution and country. This is policy guidance, not a determination of Daffodil ownership.

sources.title: NASA Space Apps: participant FAQs
sources.verified_claim: The current event supports varied backgrounds and local or virtual participation, with explicit participant conditions, capacity/waitlist and safeguarding arrangements. Used as an operating example; NASA terms are not adopted as DUDOS rules.

sources.title: NASA Space Apps: 2025 awards
sources.verified_claim: The 2025 awards page documents named award purposes and local-to-global expert judging. This supports a transparent challenge model; it is a historical example, not a verified 2026 judging rule or affiliation.

sources.title: UNESCO: introduction to the Recommendation on Open Science
sources.verified_claim: Open-science guidance supports participation and reuse with proportionate restrictions for privacy, confidentiality and IP. The introductory PDF was read; the UNESCO legal-affairs HTML page rejected direct retrieval and was not treated as verified full-text legal evidence.

sources.title: ORCID: collecting and sharing ORCID iDs
sources.verified_claim: Authenticated ORCID collection uses OAuth and researcher authorization. API use has eligibility/terms; the public API is described as free for non-commercial services, so DUDOS commercial use must verify the appropriate arrangement. ORCID does not certify project quality or ownership.

sources.title: Google Search Central: managing multi-regional and multilingual sites
sources.verified_claim: Separate language URLs and discoverable language choices support international search. Language and country are distinct dimensions; avoid preventing access to other versions through automatic language redirects. No ranking result is guaranteed.

sources.title: Google Search Central: localized versions of pages
sources.verified_claim: Alternate-language annotations need valid supported codes, fully qualified URLs, self and reciprocal references; x-default may identify a fallback. Google does not use the HTML lang attribute or hreflang to detect page language.

sources.title: W3C: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
sources.verified_claim: WCAG 2.2 provides testable accessibility criteria including keyboard operation, understandable input, language, focus and accessible authentication. Use the existing DUDOS AA target with complete-process manual testing; design text alone is not conformance.

sources.title: W3C Internationalization: structural markup and right-to-left text
sources.verified_claim: Set base text direction through markup, use logical layout properties, and handle mixed-direction user content explicitly. Language and direction are independent declarations.

scope_limits: This workstream reviewed the retained DUDOS sections, source-qualified EDU-RDI-001 template and prior yellow DOL/AI analysis. It does not claim to audit actual campus datasets, employment/student contracts, IP ownership, budgets, talent availability or country laws.
The new team folder and ICC transformation case are reconciled by companion workstreams; this file makes no claim to have inspected their runtime or rights.
All proposed fields, tests, metrics and routines are documentation/design. No awards, enrollment, agent job, publication, model training, production release or recurring automation was activated.

Design adoption, implementation-contract completion, sandbox entry and production release are separate decisions. Unresolved rights or country evidence blocks only the affected action; safe analysis and unrelated authorized work can continue.
